solution: A failure affecting one region need not stop the entire service because another region has the data and running service needed to take over. This reduces dependence on one physical site, though it does not eliminate all common software or provider failures.

marking_points.criterion: Explains alternate site can take over after regional failure.
Links distribution to reduced single-site outage dependence with stated failover assumption.
